text: this is a good idea. It's a bit thin. It would be nice to have something at the bottom to hold it down.  I love the pocket at the top, but the wind can catch the bottom and blow it off.  this is still better than just laying a towel.  At least the top doesn't fall on you each time you sit down. I like the colors.

STAY-PUT POCKET: 8" pocket fits over the top of your lounge chair to keep the towel in place; No more dealing with the wind blowing your towel away or having it slide and bunch up while you try to get comfortable
